messages:
sabrina: FYI AcmeCorp is seeing the streaming JSON (mode=json, stream=true) cut off mid-object. Their parser throws JSONParseError. They said it was fine this morning and started failing after a deploy.
kevin: Do we have the exact curl/SDK they used?
sabrina: Customer paste:
```bash
curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-4-small\",\"mode\":\"json\",\"stream\":true,\"prompt\":\"...\"}' \\
  https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate
```
kevin: Thanks. Any proxies between them and our edge?
maya: Yes internal corporate proxy -> Cloudflare -> our edge.
eli: Typical failure mode: an intermediate closes the TCP stream (idle timeout or max header/body time) in-between server-sent chunks. If a chunk gets cut mid-object you get truncated JSON on the client.
ops-bot: alert: edge-proxy idle-timeout (us-east-1) increased closed_conns=47 at 2025-09-12T10:14:03Z
sabrina: They sent the raw tail they observed: "...\n\"answer\":\"OK\"\n" and the stream ends there (missing final closing brace). Parser error: Unexpected end of JSON input.
kevin: Can they reproduce locally? Ask for curl --raw --no-buffer and tcpdump of the last 2s. Also request the X-Request-ID if available.
maya: Quick repro we tried: run the same curl -N and kill connection (SIGINT) on the server between two chunks -> client sees same truncated-tail error. Minimal repro attached.
eli: Workarounds: enable chunk keepalive heartbeats, or switch to non-streaming json mode (single response) while we patch idle timeouts. For a proper fix we need infra to relax/prolong proxy downstream idle window or ensure final chunk flush before FIN.
sabrina: I'll collect customer's tcpdump + X-Request-ID and escalate to infra. Also asked them to retry with streaming disabled to confirm.
maya: :thumbsup: If infra can't relax timeout quickly I'll open a Cloudflare support ticket referencing closed_conns spike.
kevin: Noted. Keeping this thread for updates
